aiResearchSummary.text: Sila Nanotechnologies Inc. is focused on advancing lithium-ion battery technology with innovations in electrode and electrolyte compositions. They are developing multi-shell structures for battery active materials, high-capacity anodes, and electrolytes tailored for improved performance. Their research includes the stabilization of Li-ion battery anodes using hydrofluoric acid neutralizing agents, metal sulfide composite materials, and methods for increasing metal content in batteries. They are also exploring solid-state electrolytes for enhanced safety and performance, as well as core-shell composites for electrodes. Each R&D effort aims to enhance energy density, safety, and longevity of batteries for electric vehicles.
